Ingrid Reyes
ingrid.reyes@example.com | New York, NY
Ingrid Reyes has 8 years of experience in design. Most recently, Senior Product
Designer at Brackenridge Consulting (2023-2026), where they designed and
prototyped features in Figma used by 14+ engineers to build against. Before
that, Product Designer at Vineland Logistics (2018-2023). Education: B.S.
Digital Media, Drexel University, 2018. Core skills: Design systems,
Wireframing, Adobe XD, Visual design, Prototyping, Figma.
